name: HeyGen HyperFrames
desc: Agent-driven video studio that renders plain HTML into finished video
desc_zh: 把普通 HTML 渲染成成片的 Agent 视频工作台
solves: Localizing a campaign into a dozen languages needs its tool, headcount and budget. HyperFrames treats the webpage markup as the video input, so one composition renders every variant.
solves_zh: 一次投放要译成十几种语言，通常得单独的工具和人手。HyperFrames 把网页标记当作视频输入，一个构图渲染所有变体。
best_for: When a localized campaign needs a hundred video cuts shipped before the standup meeting.
best_for_zh: 本地化投放要在一早的例会前交出一百条视频剪辑的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — HeyGen blog monthly release roundups (heygen.com/blog), "What's new at HeyGe）。 The May 2026 roundup says the idea grew into a full studio during May, so only the month is certain. Shipped as a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux plus a web studio, and released Apache-2.0 on GitHub as heygen-com/hyperframes. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「HyperFrames」，卡片上带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.heygen.com/blog/heygen-may-2026-release 首次公开日期仅精确到月。
